title: 1981-04-16_Pat_45.txt
concise_summary: PKD synthesizes Pauline Christology with Platonic metaphysics and Gnostic soteriology to argue that Christ operates as a cosmic Logos liberating humans from deterministic enslavement by breaking the Torah's programming power through gnosis—experiential knowledge restructuring one's perception of reality from concrete to abstract. He develops Ditheon as a model where Christ as eternal eidos relates to the world through multiple spatio-temporal particulars (PKD and Thomas as exemplars), creating a superorganism that transubstantiates both cosmos and human consciousness.
key_claims: Christ deflects fate not through miracle but by reading and negating the Torah (book of the spinners/Plasmate) that programs astral determinism and occluded human consciousness
The meta-abstraction (sudden gnostic realization that reality is information, not concrete) breaks the power of the Plasmate to compel assent and constitutes genuine freedom
Ditheon (two-psyche entity) models Christ as eidos existing prior to and deriving from two disparate human particulars located in different spacetimes, unified by one ruling psyche
Physical resurrection and temporal immortality are literally transmitted through Christ's phylogenic (species-spanning) mind linking believers in a superorganism distributed across space and time
The axis concrete-to-abstract is identical to the axis enslavement-to-freedom; acquiring wisdom involves progressive conceptual abstracting, not logical deduction
Torah unwittingly contains a hidden account of Christ's mystery because Torah by nature conforms to and reveals the universe
